prompts.base: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: attached original game hero sprite sheet. Create a new costume on EXACTLY the same boy in EXACTLY the same sixteen poses, coordinates, facing, body proportions, size and 4 by 4 layout. Costume: elegant white-gray hooded assassin inspired by Assassin's Creed: prominent pointed ivory hood worn UP in EVERY frame, gray cloth mask covering nose mouth and lower face, recognizable amber eyes and a tiny brown fringe visible within hood, tailored ivory split robe with gray shaded folds, dark brown leather crossing chest straps and belt, restrained burgundy waist sash, engraved silver bracers, dark pants and leather boots. Back poses show hood covering hair. Replace green cape with short ivory split coat tails. Keep SAME youthful chibi character, detailed crisp pixel sprite game art and lighting, not realistic adult. No added weapons in any cell. Exact pose mapping row1 idle and 3 run poses; row2 jump fall low palm landing tucked roll; row3 overhead hand attack, forward hand slash, low followthrough, casting; row4 bow aiming hands, throwing hand, back climbing left knee then right knee. Preserve each hand and foot location. Sixteen separated complete cutouts with transparent background, no shadows, no text, no cell lines, no overlap, no clipping. Match original sheet canvas aspect and relative cell positions. Rich beautiful pixel details, consistent outfit across all 16 frames.

This is a complete animation wardrobe edit, not a concept illustration.
